== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The remastered slip changes the opposing destiny penalty from 3 to 2 and prints attrition immunity below 3 without the Zuckuss condition. It omits the ship-docking clause, keeping the capacity, free deployment and ability to reduce opposing weapon, battle and asteroid destiny while Zuckuss pilots.
